_note: Skeleton for a factory's own duty-receipt exemptions (#506). Copy to docs/duty-receipt-exemptions.json and add ONE entry per enabled cron job attributed to your factory that legitimately declares no `receipt_subject:`. `job` must equal the row's `name` in the cron store; `reason` is why the duty owes no receipt and is printed on every run. Absent or empty means no exemptions, never a failure. This file is the SKELETON and ships empty -- a malformed `receipt_subject` in a prompt is a PROBLEM no entry here can excuse. A SECOND, NARROWER SHAPE is also honoured (#617): an entry carrying a `round` key (YYYY-MM-DD, the round's own date) excuses ONE ROUND of a job that stays judged -- the round is excluded from both the judgement and the job's latency observations, and is printed as `excused` on every run. Use it when a single round owed nothing (a declared repair, a known outage) while the rest of the job's history is real promptness data. An entry with NO `round` key keeps its job-wide meaning and never excuses a round.
